In an abelian category, left exact (0→X→Y→Z exact implies 0→F(X)→F(Y)→F(Z) exact) is equivalent to preserving finite limits, and right exact is equivalent to preserving finite colimits. This equivalence is a standard theorem in homological algebra and is established in Mathlib. The exact functor concept (both simultaneously) follows by combining the two declarations.
